Name: Fish Catch Checker
Author: ridwan12dvk
Description:
[center][size=6][b]Why Can't I Catch This Fish?[/b][/size]
[i]Stop guessing. Pick a fish, and the game tells you exactly why it will — or won't — bite right now.[/i][/center]

[line]

[size=5][b]🎣 What it does[/b][/size]
Pick any fish and instantly check whether it can be caught right now. If not, the mod explains the blockers in plain language, including season, time, weather, location, fishing level, rod requirements,
catch limits, and many special conditions for vanilla and many modded fish.

Instead of tabbing out to the wiki or digging through game data, you get a clear in-game answer built for players.

[size=5][b]✨ Features[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][b]Instant catchability check[/b] — see whether a fish can be caught right now at a glance.[/*]
[*][b]Plain-language explanations[/b] — understand exactly what's blocking a fish without reading raw game data.[/*]
[*][b]Works with vanilla and many modded fish[/b] — supports fish added through standard Stardew Valley data.[/*]
[*][b]Shows common blockers clearly[/b] — including season, time, weather, location, fishing level, rod requirements, catch limits, and more.[/*]
[*][b]Natural Collections integration[/b] — open Fish Catch Checker directly from [b]Collections > Fish[/b] using the magnifying-glass icon.[/*]
[*][b]Configurable hotkey[/b] — the original keyboard shortcut remains available for quick access.[/*]
[*][b]Uncaught fish filter[/b] — focus on vanilla and modded fish you still need for collection completion.[/*]
[*][b]Season-aware search[/b] — search for [i]spring[/i], [i]summer[/i], [i]fall[/i], or [i]winter[/i] to find every fish available during that season, including multi-season and unrestricted fish.[/*]
[*][b]Smart search[/b] — quickly find fish by name, item ID, location, source mod, or season.[/*]
[*][b]Combined filtering[/b] — use season search together with the Uncaught filter to find fish you still need in a specific season.[/*]
[*][b]Player-first UI[/b] — the most important blockers are shown first, with extra details underneath.[/*]
[*][b]Multiplayer-safe[/b] — the inspector is client-side and uses each player's own collection progress.[/*]
[*][b]Multilingual support[/b] — full translations for English, Indonesian (Bahasa Indonesia), and Simplified Chinese (简体中文). The UI automatically matches your game's language.[/*]
[*][b]IME keyboard support[/b] — the search bar supports Chinese and other non-ASCII input for seamless searching in your preferred language.[/*]
[/list]
[size=5][b]🎯 Great for[/b][/size]
[list]
[*]Figuring out why a fish won't appear[/*]
[*]Checking fish requirements without opening the wiki[/*]
[*]Planning collections, quests, and perfection runs[/*]
[*]Testing fish from content mods and fish packs[/*]
[*]Saving time when a specific fish keeps refusing to bite[/*]
[/list]
[size=5][b]🚀 Getting started[/b][/size]
[list]
[*]Install [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url] (4.0.0+).[/*]
[*]Unzip this mod into your [b]Stardew Valley/Mods[/b] folder.[/*]
[*]Launch the game through SMAPI.[/*]
[*]Press [b]Left Shift + H[/b] (default) to open the fish inspector.[/*]
[*]Select a fish on the left and read its catch requirements on the right.[/*]
[/list]
[size=5][b]⚙️ Configuration[/b][/size]
Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] (optional) to change settings in-game:
[list]
[*][b]Open fish inspector[/b] — rebind the hotkey (default: Left Shift + H).[/*]
[*][b]Show only fish items[/b] — keep the list focused on actual fish items instead of non-fish spawn entries.[/*]
[/list]
[size=5][b]🔌 Compatibility[/b][/size]
[list]
[*]Stardew Valley [b]1.6.0+[/b][/*]
[*][url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url] [b]4.0.0+[/b][/*]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] is optional[/*]
[*]Safe to add or remove — this mod reads game data and does not edit saves or change fishing behavior[/*]
[*]Multiplayer-safe — the inspector UI is client-side[/*]
[*]Designed for vanilla fish and many fish-adding mods that use standard Stardew 1.6 data assets[/*]
[/list]
[size=5][b]❓ FAQ[/b][/size]
[spoiler]
[b]What does this mod actually check?[/b]
It checks whether a fish can be caught right now and explains the most relevant blockers in readable language.

[b]Does it support modded fish?[/b]
Yes, it supports vanilla fish and many modded fish that use standard Stardew data.

[b]Does this change fishing behavior?[/b]
No. This mod is an information tool. It does not change fish spawns, save data, or fishing mechanics.

[b]Why doesn't a fish appear in the list?[/b]
This mod is intentionally focused on fish items. Some non-fish spawn entries or unusual custom content may not appear.

[b]Will every special condition be explained perfectly?[/b]
Many special conditions are translated into readable explanations, but some heavily custom or opaque modded rules may still be shown more generically.
[b]Q: Can I search for fish in Chinese?[/b]                                                                                                                                         
A: Yes! As of version 1.0.2, the search bar supports IME input so you can search using Chinese characters terms directly.[/spoiler]
